issues.description: Re-ingest only upserts current records and never deletes stale results, so removed or newly-invalid input rows remain in the database.
Format B assumes metrics is a dict; JSON values like string, number, or boolean crash ingest with AttributeError.
NaN and Infinity score text parse as floats instead of invalid input, allowing non-finite scores into the pipeline.
Format B accepts non-finite numeric acc values such as NaN, which can later fail SQLite NOT NULL insertion.
Format C accepts non-finite score values such as NaN and applies range logic that does not reject them.
Malformed XML raises ParseError and aborts the whole ingest instead of producing a structured malformed_row warning.
XML parsing uses stdlib ElementTree directly on input files, leaving the ingest path exposed to XML resource-exhaustion style denial of service.
Duplicate correction semantics are applied to every source even though the documented correction behavior is Format B-specific.
model_aliases is append-only across ingest runs, so aliases from removed or changed input files continue to appear in reports.
Format A reads the entire CSV file and parses it line-by-line, which breaks valid CSV records containing quoted newlines and scales poorly.
Ingesting an empty directory creates an empty SQLite database before returning the no-input-files error.
Project metadata does not declare test extras or pytest dependency, making the documented test workflow environment-dependent.
